Patch for 0.11.0: same protocol, plays with 0.11.0 (best if everyone has it)
A friend's NPC lines show in the game's subtitle area, timed with the speech (General Subtitles on)
A friendly NPC goes to the game of a friend standing next to it, so town NPCs greet and talk to both players
Crafting at a station a friend built counts your settlement's workbench junk
A friend's workshop lights light once powered (construction light, light box, strobe and more), and a friend's bulb casts light
A friend's built pieces stay tracked when their cell unloads and loads again
Dropping an item picked up from the world is shared
A killing blow on a friend's NPC reaches its game, so a Mr Gutsy no longer survives a long fall
Catch-up closes the settlement list and item inspection a friend's quest stage opens by itself
Radiant side quests with per-player targets (Automatron, Far Harbor, Nuka-World and more) are no longer shared
After a down and a revive, a stuck bleed-out camera or input lock is ended
Full notes on GitHub
